summary: MaintGoverningOrg is a web maintenance screen for managing Governing Organizations. It allows the user to add, edit, delete, and reactivate organization records. It supports fields such as name, short name, previous name, addresses, phone and fax, and includes business validation for required fields and phone/fax formats. The interface provides view filtering, validation, and dynamic controls based on user roles.
purpose: To provide administrators a platform to maintain Governing Organizations, including CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations, view filtering, and roles-based access control, ensuring organization master data integrity.

workflows.name: Add GoverningOrg
steps: Details form opens in add mode.
User enters required fields (Name, ShortName) and optional fields.
Validation performed (required fields, phone/fax format if mask enabled).
Record added to database; grid view refreshes.

workflows.name: Edit GoverningOrg
steps: Details form opens in edit mode populated with selected organization's data.
Validation performed (required fields, phone/fax format if mask enabled).
Record updated in database; grid view refreshes.

workflows.name: Delete GoverningOrg
steps: If not allowed, error message added.

workflows.name: Reactivate GoverningOrg
steps: User clicks 'Reactivate' button for inactive organization.

workflows.name: Filter View
steps: User enters keyword text and/or toggles 'Show Inactive' checkbox.
Grid view updates to show matching organizations.

business_rules: Only administrators with edit permissions can modify data.
Name and ShortName must be specified (required).
Phone and Fax numbers validated via mask if UsePhoneMask is enabled.
Cannot delete organizations if not allowed; shows error.
Inactive state determines edit/delete/reactivate button visibility.
validations: Required field validation on Name and ShortName.
Phone and Fax custom validator using client-side function if mask enabled.
PreviousNameEffectiveDate regular expression validator for date format.
conditions: Screen is editable for administrators only.
UserSession.UsePhoneMask determines if phone/fax validation is active.
Page load and postback triggers for refreshing data.
Header and row controls change based on inactivity and edit permissions.
system_behavior: GridView supports add, edit, delete, reactivate, and filter actions.
DetailsView uses dynamic field controls and validation.
Validation summaries and error/warning panels shown for feedback.
exceptions: Cannot delete organization: business rule violation yields error message.
Validation errors shown for missing/invalid fields.
content_gaps: Business logic for organization deletion (what conditions prevent deletion) not fully described.
Field-level security and auditing rules not explicitly detailed.
No information on extensibility for additional fields.
No details on error handling for database operations.
